t: Muttar lehasim beereb shabbat dabar qar al dabar chamma
s: Muttar lehasim beereb shabbat dabar qar al dabar chamma ubo seip echad: muttar lehatmin mibbeod yom, ben tabshil cham ben tabshil qar, al gabbe qedera rotachat, veen zeh kematmin al gabbe dabar hammosip hebel sheasur apillu mibbeod yom, lepi sheen haqqedera harotachat niqra mosip hebel, shehare chummah holek umitmaet.
